"""Historical mock use case, explicitly synthetic, manual and isolated by source."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import uuid


def run_demo(api, params):
    settings = api.extension.settings()
    if settings.get("demo_enabled") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Synthetic demo is disabled in Hammerjack setup")
    selected = params.get("demo_portal_id")
    if not isinstance(selected, str) or not selected:
        raise ValueError("Explicitly select a dedicated synthetic Hammerjack demo portal")
    try:
        uuid.UUID(selected)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise ValueError("Synthetic portal ID must be a UUID") from error
    portal = api.portals.get(portal_id=selected)
    if not isinstance(portal, dict) or not str(portal.get("name", "")).startswith("Synthetic Hammerjack"):
        raise ValueError("Only an explicitly named Synthetic Hammerjack portal may receive mock rows")
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    month = now[:7]
    employee = "synthetic:hammerjack:employee-001"
    for entity, external_id, payload in [
        ("attendance", employee, {"employee_name": "Synthetic employee", "clock_in_time": "09:00", "work_location": "onsite", "status": "present", "attendance_rate_mtd": 95}),
        ("leave_balance", employee, {"employee_name": "Synthetic employee", "month": month, "pto_balance_ending": 10, "pto_used_month": 1}),
        ("leave_request", "synthetic:hammerjack:leave-001", {"employee_name": "Synthetic employee", "type": "Synthetic vacation", "start_date": now[:10], "end_date": now[:10], "status": "approved"}),
        ("attendance_month", employee + ":" + month, {"employee_name": "Synthetic employee", "month": month, "days_present": 19, "days_late": 1, "days_absent": 0, "working_days": 20, "attendance_rate": 95}),
        ("scorecard", employee + ":" + month, {"employee_name": "Synthetic employee", "month": month, "score": 4.075, "attendance_component": 4.75, "review_component": 4, "review_count": 1}),
    ]:
        api.snapshots.upsert(portal_id=selected, source="hammerjack_demo", entity_type=entity, replace=False,
                             rows=[{"external_id": external_id, "payload": payload, "observed_at": now}])
    return {"source": "hammerjack_demo", "portal_id": selected, "synthetic_rows": 5}


result = run_demo(api, params)
